note: THE RETURN CONTRACT, frozen before kg has the name, and it is the whole reason `compare-strings' is not `string='. Emacs answers (-3 t 3 -3 3): equal spans answer `t' and NOT an integer, and every other answer is +/-(1+ the number of characters that COMPARED EQUAL), signed by which side sorts first. Two of the five are the case s-shared-start is built on -- a string that runs out is a mismatch too, so ("ab" vs "abc") is -3 and not `t', and s.el's `(substring s1 0 (1- (abs cmp)))' recovers the shared prefix from exactly that arithmetic. kg answers `void-function' at this pin.
